about.title: About KORA Blooms
about.text: KORA Blooms is a Prague flower studio in Karlín where flowers are more than decoration — they are a language of emotion. We hand-tie every bouquet with devotion to color, scent, and detail. Our motto: Beyond flowers, emotions bloom.
about.story: KORA Blooms grew out of Prague's Karlín district from a love of quality floristry. Beyond hand-tied bouquets we offer floral decor for venues, business collaborations, and our own line of Wild Coast KORA scented candles. Every bouquet deserves to be a small work of art – carefully assembled, beautifully wrapped, and delivered with love within 1 hour in Prague or anywhere in the Czech Republic.
about.value1Text: Every day we source only the freshest blooms from trusted European growers.
about.value2Text: Each bouquet is one-of-a-kind — hand-tied by our florists in Karlín, Prague.
about.value3Text: Our signature KORA Blooms wrap delights before the ribbon is even untied.
about.followText: See our latest bouquets and get inspired.
